description: SQLAlchemy ORM models for the Career Navigator backend, defining data models for roles, skills, their relationships, and user progress tracking.

classes.name: TimestampMixin
classes.description: Provides created_at and updated_at timestamp fields for models.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a job role with associated skills and levels.

classes.name: Skill
classes.description: Represents a skill that can be linked to roles.

classes.name: RoleSkill
classes.description: Associative table between Role and Skill with required proficiency level.

classes.name: UserProgress
classes.description: Tracks a user's proficiency level for a specific skill.

methods.name: __repr__
methods.description: Provides a string representation for debugging for each class.
